params.body:
Closes #1128

## Why

#1114 put the three provider calls of a chassis lookup into a 24-second budget and gave AutoConnect at most 10 seconds. That was too short. Measured on production from VWE's row to AutoConnect's row of the same vehicle, 166 of the 355 answers kept in the 60 days before 24 November took more than 10 seconds, and 48 took more than 20.

From the release on 24 November 15:13, all 8 AutoConnect lookups on production kept `"0"` (cURL's `false`). They cover 5 chassis numbers from at least two garages, and every one of those sheets came back with VWE's fields only.

## What changes

- **`OwnStockService::AUTOCONNECT_SECONDS = 20`.** This becomes the default cap of `getVehicleDataByVinLookup`, still inside `lookupSeconds` and the 24-second budget.
  - About six answers in seven now arrive within the request.
  - `KeepAutoConnectAnswer` (#1125) fetches the rest, and the next lookup uses the kept answer.
- **Comments.** They no longer say 10 seconds.
- **Rules and findings.**
  - R S1-2.23 names the 20 seconds.
  - New finding: `tien-seconden-voor-autoconnect-was-te-kort`.

## Tests

- `ALateAutoConnectAnswerIsKeptForTheNextLookupTest` pins the cap: at least 20 seconds and below the budget.
- The full suite is green (3330) on the main before #1127. After the rebase, the lookup tests and the rules tests are green, and so is PHPStan.
params.title: AutoConnect gets 20 seconds of a chassis lookup instead of 10
